answer_1.quote: PreQuEL is the task of predicting the likelihood of an MT system to correctly translate a given sentence to a given target language.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on predicting the quality of machine-translated outputs based on source sentences without generating translations directly.

answer_2.quote: We propose an automatic method to acquire more translation quality scores, dispensing with the costly human annotations. Automatic evaluation metrics give additional information on translation quality.

answer_4.quote: Each translation was rated following the FLORES guidelines.
answer_4.guideline: According to the FLORES guidelines, a translation that closely preserves the semantics of the source sentence gets a DA score of 70-90. Only a perfect translation gets a score of 91-100.
